description: A 57-second scripted fly-around (1280x720, 30 fps, no HUD, no manual input) of a small grass terrace cut into a hillside by the sea, captured from this task's own client build (the harbor_base state). 0:00-0:11: the apple tree; its leafy canopy sits up and off to one side of its trunk while the apples hang where the canopy should be. 0:11-0:13: the fence; the last post next to the trunk is not joined to it, while every other post joins its neighbours and the gate. 0:13-0:21: the water channel; seen through its glass wall, the water's side steps down in flat steps with dark wedge-shaped gaps under a smoothly sloping surface, and, in the top-down view, the flowing pattern on the surface travels across the channel instead of along it (clearest in motion). 0:21-0:27: the track; straight pieces and both ramps are right, but the curve at the south-east corner and the branch off the north leg are drawn turned half a turn, away from the rails they join. 0:27-0:34: the post; the torch on its south side is right, the other three lie along the wall, point into it or float on the far side of their node. 0:34-0:41: the column; the furnaces on its north and south sides show their fronts facing out, the ones on its east and west sides show a plain side where the front should be (their fronts face the column). 0:41-0:46: the bench; two of the three slabs along its front and both slabs of its side arm have no front or side face (they look like floating boards you can see under and through), while the end slab is solid. 0:46-0:52: the wheat bed; each wheat plant collapses into a cross pushed a quarter node north, so the plants stand in thin lines along the north edge of each soil block and poke out over the bed's north edge, leaving the soil bare. 0:52-0:57: the terrace from above.
reproduces: https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/issues/12536 (canopy displaced from its trunk with leaves visual_scale = 1.1, fixed upstream by https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/pull/12558) together with the seven regressions injected into this task's map block mesh pipeline (fence to trunk connection, mesh node rotation, flowing liquid corner levels, node box face culling, rail tile orientation, hash-style plant layout, turned block tile orientation).
scenario: Minetest Game 5.5.1 on a v7 world (fixed seed 135797531) with a scene mod (recording_kit/scene): default:leaves overridden to visual_scale = 1.1 (as in the issue's second screenshot); a 15x15 terrace at ground level y=8 around x=59, z=-1; a default:tree trunk at (61, 9..13, -3) with a 5x5 apple-tree canopy and six default:apple nodes; default:fence_wood from x=56 to 60 at z=-3 with doors:gate_wood_closed (facedir 2) at x=58 and a second leg at x=56 from z=-2 to 3; a default:stonebrick channel along z=-7 (floor and south wall stonebrick, north wall default:glass from x=53 to 57) fed by a default:water_source at x=53 and flowing east to x=57; carts:rail from a rail on a cobble block at (61, 10, -7) down a ramp east to (65, 9, -7), a curve north to (65, 9, -3) with a branch to (66, 9, -5), and a ramp up onto a cobble block at (65, 10, -2); a default:stonebrick post at (64, 9..10, 2) with default:torch_wall on all four sides of its top (wallmounted 2, 3, 4, 5); a default:stonebrick column at (60, 9, 1) with a floor torch on top and default:furnace on its four sides facing out (facedir 2, 0, 3, 1 for north, south, east, west); stairs:slab_wood at x=53..55, z=1 and x=53, z=2..3; farming:wheat_8 (param2 3, the game's own place_param2) on farming:soil_wet at x=62..64, z=4..5; default:glass at x=59..61, y=9..10, z=5 with connected_glass = true. Noon, fixed time, smooth lighting and fancy leaves (defaults). The camera follows a fixed scripted path; the client ran headless under Xvfb with Mesa llvmpipe and was captured with ffmpeg x11grab.
